title: His father Jefferson, a guitarist who played by ear
summary: His father Jefferson played popular songs on guitar by ear, not jazz.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. And what about your family? Were there any musicians in your family when you were born? Like your father, your uncles?
Yeah, my father was a guitar player.
Mm-hmm. And what was his name?
Jefferson Lorycanner? Yeah. Mm-hmm. And what kind of music did he play?
Play just by note or by ear?
Mm-hmm. And you remember any of the songs he played? No.
Were they just regular popular songs or classical music or Italian?
Popular songs, yeah, popular songs. Mm-hmm.
Would he play what you call jazz on the guitar? No.
